---
title: smalldocs 0.5.8
subtitle: smalldocs needs fastcore 2.0
date: 2026-11-12
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

smalldocs now needs fastcore 2.0 or newer. Before, it took fastcore 1.8.

fastcore 1.10 and older do not read the comment on a `**kwargs` parameter. So with them, a reference
page showed `**kwargs` with no description, and nothing said why. fastcore 2.0 reads the comment.

A project with fastcore 1.x gets the newest fastcore when it installs this version of smalldocs. A
project that pins fastcore below 2.0 cannot install it. A project that had fastcore 1.10 or older now
gets the comment on `**kwargs` on its reference pages. Nothing else changes.
